intent: Count how many of the six specified product variants have available_today_quantity >= 4 at the central Salzburg PowerTool store today.

params.line1: Metabo Silent W 1P3-96C Compressor and Dust Extractor
params.line2: Stanley Classic FM 2AE-LHO Screwdriver and Hex Key Set
params.line3: Hazet Precision 900 2NG-Q9V Screwdriver and Hex Key Set
params.line4: Varta Workshop Silver 2KH-QZR Automotive Charger and Bulb
params.line5: Bolle Safety Ventilated BOL 8SW-64L Safety Eyewear

success_criteria: The central Salzburg PowerTool store is resolved by city='Salzburg' and a central-branch name match
Each of the six lines is matched to its specific variant by brand + product_family_name + distinguishing variant properties
Only variants with available_today_quantity >= 4 at that store are counted
refs cite the record_path of only the available (>=4) matched variants, never the excluded ones

args: SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name, city, is_open FROM stores WHERE city = :city;

WITH store AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND store_name LIKE :store_pattern), matched AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id WHERE (pv.brand = :brand1 AND pf.product_family_name = :line1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_machine_type AND p.property_value_text=:v_machine_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_voltage AND p.property_value_text=:v_voltage) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_power AND p.property_value_text=:v_power) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_tank AND p.property_value_text=:v_tank)) OR (pv.brand = :brand2 AND pf.product_family_name = :line2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_tool_profile AND p.property_value_text=:v_tool_profile2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_piece_count AND p.property_value_text=:v_piece_count)) OR (pv.brand = :brand3 AND pf.product_family_name = :line3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_tool_profile AND p.property_value_text=:v_tool_profile3)) OR (pv.brand = :brand4 AND pf.product_family_name = :line4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_product_type AND p.property_value_text=:v_product_type)) OR (pv.brand = :brand5 AND pf.product_family_name = :line5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_lens_color AND p.property_value_text=:v_lens_color)) OR (pv.brand = :brand6 AND pf.product_family_name = :line6 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key=:k_power_source AND p.property_value_text=:v_power_source))) SELECT m.product_sku, m.record_path AS record_path, si.available_today_quantity FROM matched m JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = m.product_sku JOIN store s ON s.store_id = si.store_id WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= :min_available;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session. Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
